units.source_text: 穿过茶室下面的小道，就是水池。

en.t: Passing along the path below the tea room, you came to the pond.

units.source_text: 池畔的菖蒲叶悠悠嫩绿，挺拔多姿。

en.t: Beside the pond, the iris leaves were a soft, lingering young green, upright and graceful in many forms.

units.source_text: 睡莲的叶子也漂浮在水面上。

en.t: The water lily leaves were also floating on the surface of the water.
